appearancetable.name: C&O 1943 Color Light (2 head, interlocking/diverging)
appearancetable.reference: Two-lamp-head mast: top head carries the same Clear/Approach/Stop indication as the 1-head mast, bottom head is the diverging-route modifier, dark when the route is normal (lined through). Use at interlockings, passing-siding turnouts, and other locations with a diverging move - e.g. Afton, and any of the passing sidings along Louisa-Gordonsville-Charlottesville- Staunton (Trevilian, Mineral, Frederick Hall, etc., if you're signaling those turnouts). Absolute (interlocking) use only - pairs with "Stop", not "Stop and Proceed", since two-head masts on the prototype were typically home/interlocking signals rather than plain automatic blocks.

appearance.reference: C&O practice for Restricting at this date (lunar-white lamp vs. a red-over-yellow combination) is not confirmed here - check against the actual rulebook before relying on this row.
